# Lacuna v0.1.0 release candidate 1

This is Lacuna's first externally testable release candidate: a focused signal-validation path for
finding weak evidence, temporal leakage, and incomplete research assumptions before a strategy is
trusted.

## Included

- explicit forward-return labels with observation, entry, and half-open earning intervals;
- Pearson and average-rank Spearman IC, quantiles, spreads, monotonicity, turnover, and decay;
- walk-forward and purged validation with embargo;
- deterministic IID, moving, circular, and stationary bootstrap intervals;
- versioned audit findings, evidence coverage, and JSON/Markdown/self-contained HTML reports;
- Polars, NumPy, pandas, and Arrow-compatible boundaries with copy/materialization diagnostics;
- native Rust kernels for grouped rank IC, bootstrap means, and interval purging;
- a regression-tested `0.1.x` Python API and audit-result schema v1.

## Distribution

The release contains one source distribution and CPython 3.11+ stable-ABI wheels for:

- Linux x86_64 and aarch64 (`manylinux_2_28`);
- macOS arm64;
- Windows x86_64.

Every wheel is installed and smoke-tested on its target architecture. `SHA256SUMS` records the exact
artifact digests, and GitHub build-provenance attestations bind them to this tagged workflow.
RC1 is not published to PyPI because that registry's `lacuna` distribution belongs to an unrelated
project; install the attached GitHub artifact directly.

## What to test

Run `lacuna doctor --json`, execute the quick-start study against a non-sensitive independent data
sample, compare at least one statistic with an existing calculation, inspect all `UNKNOWN` findings,
and review the input copy/materialization diagnostics.

Please submit results through the
[v0.1 RC feedback form](https://github.com/eyenoticeall/Lacuna/issues/new?template=rc-feedback.yml).
Do not attach proprietary data, credentials, or sensitive strategy details.

## Known boundary

Lacuna remains pre-1.0 research software. This candidate does not include parameter robustness,
experiment registries, cost/capacity analysis, point-in-time joins, PSR/DSR, or advanced inference.
It is not a broker, live-trading system, full backtester, or source of investment advice.
